title.zh: North Korean Hackers Moved $38M Through Relay Protocol in 7 Hours
title.en: North Korean Hackers Moved $38M Through Relay Protocol in 7 Hours

current_state.zh: On-chain analyst Specter reported that North Korean hackers moved roughly $38 million through cross-chain bridge Relay Protocol in about seven hours, with transfers ongoing, and that Relay's Know Your Transaction monitoring failed to block them despite the difficulty of moving such volume through THORChain in the same window.
current_state.en: On-chain analyst Specter reported that North Korean hackers moved roughly $38 million through cross-chain bridge Relay Protocol in about seven hours, with transfers ongoing, and that Relay's Know Your Transaction monitoring failed to block them despite the difficulty of moving such volume through THORChain in the same window.
